title: Backend calculator subtract helper
objective: Implement a backend subtract(a, b) helper in calculator.py that returns a minus b and makes the existing test_subtract pass.
scope: Change only calculator.py in the disposable calculator repository.
requirements: Keep add(a, b) working. Add subtract(a, b) using ordinary Python arithmetic. No new dependencies.
constraints: One local code change only; no deployment, publication, or changes to other projects.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] add(7, 3) returns 10.
- [ ] subtract(7, 3) returns 4.
- [ ] The existing unittest discovery command passes.
security_considerations: No external I/O, secrets, network access, or authority changes are needed.
testing_requirements: Run /usr/bin/python3 -m unittest discover -v and record the result.
